field-75: At Optum I rebuilt claims ingestion on Azure Data Factory + Databricks into a Delta Lake bronze-silver-gold model with Snowflake loads via COPY INTO / MERGE. It cut new-source onboarding from ~2 weeks to ~4 days and raised scheduled pipeline success from ~97% to 99.5% — favorite because analysts could trust the silver layer and I owned the end-to-end reliability path.
